ItemID: NA; Title: 25; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This does not clearly connect with the blues and roots rock I want right now.

ItemID: NA; Title: The Mamas & the Papas - Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am in the mood for bluesy guitar rather than harmony-driven pop.
ItemID: NA; Title: Earth Wind & Fire Greatest Hits; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Funk and soul are not what I am looking for this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Very Best Of The Rolling Stones 1964-1971; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Their blues-rooted rock appeals to me, but I would rather explore an album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: All Over the World - The Very Best of Electric Light Orchestra; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for something rootsier than orchestral pop rock.
